pages.title: Mark Baisley for United States Senate
pages.text:
## Mark is Securing Liberty and Protecting Colorado Families.
For years, Mark Baisley has stood up for hardworking families, defended our water rights, protected our energy industry, and pushed back against reckless spending and government overreach in the state senate. He knows that America’s promises are most effectively secured when the abundance of liberty is protected, rather than government encroaching on the lives of Americans. Now, he’s ready to take that fearless leadership to Washington.
## The Problem-Solver Colorado Needs in the US Senate
Mark Baisley leads a Colorado software company in the development of interactive systems visualization technology, the culmination of Mark’s long career as an aerospace engineer with Martin Marietta, Hughes, Raytheon and NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
Mark served as Chairman of the Colorado Space Business Roundtable, advancing Colorado’s defense / aerospace industry. He received a commendation from Ambassador Cooper for his work on the Ballistic Missile Defense Initiative. Mark was awarded the Professional Achievement Award from his alma mater, Columbia College, where he served for 12 years on the Board of Trustees after earning his Bachelor’s degree with majors in Computer Information Systems and Business Administration.
In 2018, Mark was elected to the Colorado State House of Representatives. In 2022, he was elected to the Colorado State Senate where he serves today. Mark has received over 30 awards from organizations such as Liberty Scorecard, the Colorado Union of Taxpayers and the Economic Development Council of Colorado recognizing him as one of Colorado’s most effective State Senators. He is now the Republican nominee for United States Senate in 2026.
## Securing the Promise of America
Mark Baisley is committed to solving real problems, protecting liberty, and improving all Coloradans’ lives.
## Finding Solutions that Meet Everyone’s Needs.
As an engineer, Mark has spent his life finding solutions that meet people’s needs and improve the world around us. Throughout his life, Mark has used this engineer mindset to improve the lives of Coloradans across our state:
Established STEM Charter School to help students prepare for their future
Strengthened security serving as Co-Chair of the Aerospace and Defense Caucus in the Colorado Senate
Played a key role in winning the Quantum Computing “Tech Hub” designation for Colorado
Brought manufacturing jobs to Colorado with the CHIPS and Science Act
Helped bring the Sundance Film Festival to Colorado
Introduced AI legislation that protects economic growth, innovation, and privacy

pages.title: Issues - Mark Baisley for United States Senate
pages.text:
## Affordability & Prosperity
Mark Baisley’s vision is a Colorado — and an America — where businesses thrive and every worker — whether blue-collar, energy, agriculture, or high-tech — has a real shot at a strong paycheck and a secure future.
As a businessman and state senator, Mark has proven he can innovate and win. He understands that prosperity doesn’t come from Washington mandates — it comes from unleashing the private sector. In the United States Senate, he will fight to cut federal taxes, roll back job-killing regulations, restore American energy dominance, and make the US a magnet for employers — not a playground for unelected bureaucrats.
## Safe, Prosperous Communities
Mark Baisley is committed to making Colorado safe for everyone—no matter where they live. Mark will work with law enforcement to give them the support and funding they need to keep us safe. Similarly, Mark will work to end the dangerous programs that put violent criminals back into our neighborhoods before they’ve rehabilitated.
You can count on Mark to put your family first and to make Colorado safe. Recent policies may have put our families in danger, but Mark knows we can make our communities safe and prosperous again.
## Immigration
People from around the globe see the exceptional character of American liberty and naturally believe that they also deserve to live in an environment of Natural Law — and they do. More than any other nation, America is enriched by immigrants “yearning to breathe free.” And each year, 1.2 million people are legally invited to live in the United States. These welcomed souls are vetted to ensure that they:
- Are not violent or dishonorable
- Will be self-reliant contributors
- Will proudly assimilate into American culture
Those applicants who are not fortunate enough to share in the American inheritance should establish Natural Law in their native countries by pledging to each other their lives, their fortunes and their sacred honor.
## Agriculture
America’s farmers and ranchers remain the backbone of our domestic economy and national food security. They feed our families and fuel significant portions of rural economic activity. At the same time, they face structural cost pressures that punish hard work and make sustained profitability harder to achieve.
Senator Mark Baisley has a consistent record of fighting government overreach, cutting red tape, and backing private sector solutions in the Colorado State Senate. He understands that durable prosperity comes from freer markets rather than expanded bureaucracy or dependency programs.

## Join Mark for United States Senate
Like Andrew Jackson and Theodore Roosevelt,
## Mark is
a disruptor. accountable. balanced. principled. an innovator. courageous. empathetic. transparent. original.
His pioneering tech background heightened national security, while his late-night hacks outsmarted the best, landing him in the U.S. Intelligence Community to safeguard America’s critical assets.
## Mark Works For Colorado You Parents Medical Sovereignty Affordability Liberty
Senator Baisley defines “affordability” as the breathing space between what people earn and what it costs them to live. The larger government becomes, the more it takes from that space where families need to breathe. And when that space is too small, people stress about the basic costs of life. They struggle to keep their aging cars operating and young Americans are unable to buy their first home.
The Trump Administration is eliminating waste, cutting fraud and reducing the federal government footprint. As economic conditions improve, it will be critical for the federal government to resist seizing fresh prosperity for new programs. As a member of the United States Senate, Mark Baisley will be a strong and effective voice to keep Washington on its limited and efficient course.
In the United States Senate, Mark Baisley will focus on facilitating market forces in healthcare to increase responsiveness and reduce costs. When patients have the power to make purchase decisions at the recommendations of their doctors, they will be in control of their health. This will include approving their own treatments rather than an insurance bureaucrat. This will include having the power to shop for the best value for services like generic drugs and MRIs.
Senator Baisley supports creative ideas like Florida’s US Senator Rick Scott’s “More Affordable Care Act.”
There are very few appropriate roles for government beyond the defense of the People’s rights. One of those good roles is the facilitation of commerce. That includes the building of roads for the transportation of food, stock and merchandise as well as the safe mobility of people in their cars. Colorado hosts two main transportation arteries, Interstate 70 and Interstate 25. While both freeways are critical, I-70 is in desperate need of increased capacity. Beyond the heavy weekend traffic to Colorado’s mountain resorts, ranchers and businesses across the state rely on I-70 to move their products. This is a federal government responsibility that Senator Baisley sees as a priority for Colorado’s partnership with Washington D.C.

pages.text:
## Mark Baisley’s Campaign Platform
Mark Baisley is running for U.S. Senate in 2026 to bring private-sector muscle and fearless leadership to a state choked by waste, weak policies, and agendas that simply don’t support Colorado citizens. A tech titan who built effective organizations at NASA and secured $2 trillion for America, Mark is ready to support Colorado like a business—efficient, accountable, and built for the people. Here’s how he will deliver.
## thatMark Baisley’s Campaign Platform
Mark Baisley is running for U.S. Senate in 2026 to bring private-sector muscle and fearless leadership to a state choked by waste, weak policies, and agendas that simply don’t support Colorado citizens. A tech titan who built effective organizations at NASA and secured $2 trillion for America, Mark is ready to support Colorado like a business—efficient, accountable, and built for the people. Here’s how he will deliver.
## Destroying Government Waste: Efficiency That Works
Colorado’s bureaucracy is a bloated mess, bleeding taxpayer dollars while delivering excuses while dismissing Constitutional guarantees. Mark will slash waste with the precision of a tech CEO, bringing private-sector accountability to Denver. He’s launched companies, created jobs, and outsmarted hackers—now he’ll fire the dead weight, streamline services, and demand results. No more endless red tape; Mark’s track record proves he can cut costs and make systems work.
## Fixing the Economy: Jobs and Opportunity for All
Mark’s vision is a Colorado where businesses thrive and every worker—blue-collar or high-tech—has a shot at a good paycheck. He can innovate and he can win. He will cut taxes, ditch job-killing regulations, and make Colorado a magnet for employers, not a playground for bureaucrats. He’s done it before. In addition to creating jobs as a businessman, he’s carried bills like HB 23-1260 and HB 24-1325, securing quantum tech hubs and tax incentives alongside Governor Polis to bring business to our state.
## Fixing Education: Parents First, Industry Ready
Education is broken—controlled by unions, not parents. Mark will modernize it, partnering with giants like the University of Colorado and the Air Force Academy to train kids for real jobs, not woke lectures. As a STEM School founder, he helped produce Time Magazine’s first “Kid of the Year”; as a legislator honored by Metro State Denver (2020) and the University of Colorado (2023), he has delivered. HB 24-1325 funded quantum tech education, empowering our state to excel in a cutting-edge industry. He will respect parents as the boss, not the state.
## Restoring Rule of Law: True Safety for Coloradans
Colorado’s streets and forests are crying out for leadership—vagrants overrun Denver, wildfires rage, crime festers under soft policies, and the government lies about the extent of the problem while we live it every day. He will fully fund law enforcement and emergency services and build on his current work as a state senator to fight wildfires using the most advance technology available.
## Safety First: Securing Our State, Securing Our Country
It is time to end Colorado’s national embarrassment. In 2024, voters across America saw horrifying images of the illegal immigrant gang Tren de Aragua seizing an entire apartment complex in Aurora. The madness will end when Mark Baisley serves in the U.S. Senate. He will fully cooperate with ICE and reverse laws shielding criminal illegals. He already created the framework with his bill SB 25-047. Radical liberals blocked it, but Mark will make it happen in the U.S. Senate. Order will be restored.
